scheme_name: Grant to Meritorious Wards of Ex-Servicemen in Academics (Lump Sum Grant)
description:
The Grant to Meritorious Wards of Ex-Servicemen in Academics also known as Lump Sum Grant is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India. 

This scheme was launched to provide financial assistance to the children of ex-servicemen who have demonstrated excellence in their academic pursuits. 

The scheme aims to encourage educational advancement among the wards of ex-servicemen by providing them with monetary support. 

The scheme was officially launched on 1st April 2017. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide a one-time financial grant to meritorious students who are children of ex-servicemen. 

The grant is intended to support students pursuing higher education in various fields. 

The specific goal of the scheme is to ensure that deserving students receive the necessary financial assistance to further their academic careers. 

The scheme targets students who have achieved a minimum percentage of marks in their qualifying examinations. 

For students pursuing professional courses, the eligibility criterion is set at 60 percent marks in their qualifying examination. 

For students pursuing non-professional courses, the eligibility criterion is set at 50 percent marks in their qualifying examination. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is a lump sum grant of ₹25,000. 

This amount is intended to help cover various educational expenses such as tuition fees, books, and other necessary materials. 

The scheme is applicable to the wards of ex-servicemen who are defined as children or dependents of individuals who have served in the armed forces. 

The eligibility for this scheme is limited to students who are between the ages of 18 and 25 years. 

The income criteria for eligibility stipulates that the annual income of the ex-serviceman should not exceed ₹6 lakh. 

This income limit is set to ensure that the benefits of the scheme reach those who are in genuine need of financial assistance. 

To apply for the Lump Sum Grant, applicants must follow a specific application process. 

The first step in the application process is to obtain the application form. 

The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Ministry of Defence. 

Applicants must fill out the form with accurate personal and academic details. 

Along with the application form, applicants are required to submit specific documents. 

These documents include a copy of the ex-serviceman's discharge certificate. 

Applicants must also provide proof of their academic performance such as mark sheets or certificates. 

A copy of the applicant's birth certificate or any document proving the relationship with the ex-serviceman is also required. 

Additionally, a copy of the income certificate of the ex-serviceman must be submitted. 

Once the application form and documents are ready, they must be submitted to the concerned authority. 

The concerned authority is typically the Zila Sainik Board in the respective district. 

Applications can also be submitted online through the official government portal. 

The timeline for the application process is generally open throughout the academic year. 

However, it is advisable for applicants to submit their applications as early as possible to avoid any last-minute issues. 

The disbursement of the grant is typically processed within two to three months after the application is submitted. 

Successful applicants will receive the grant amount directly into their bank accounts. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. 

The Zila Sainik Board plays a crucial role in the implementation of the scheme at the district level. 

Contact details for the Zila Sainik Board can be found on the official website of the Ministry of Defence. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Government of India to support ex-servicemen and their families. 

It reflects the government's commitment to recognizing the sacrifices made by armed forces personnel. 

The scheme has been well-received and has positively impacted the educational pursuits of many meritorious students. 

As of the latest reports, thousands of students have benefited from this financial assistance since its inception. 

The scheme is regularly monitored to ensure that it reaches the intended beneficiaries effectively. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to assess the impact of the scheme on their educational outcomes. 

The government aims to continue this support and possibly expand the scheme in the future. 

Overall, the Grant to Meritorious Wards of Ex-Servicemen in Academics is a significant step towards empowering the children of ex-servicemen. 

It provides them with the necessary financial backing to pursue their academic goals without the burden of financial constraints. 

This initiative not only supports individual students but also contributes to the overall educational advancement of the community of ex-servicemen. 

The scheme exemplifies the government's dedication to ensuring that the sacrifices of ex-servicemen are honored through tangible benefits for their families. 

In conclusion, the Lump Sum Grant is a vital welfare scheme that plays an essential role in promoting education among the wards of ex-servicemen. 

It provides a structured and supportive framework for students to achieve their academic aspirations. 

The financial assistance offered under this scheme is crucial for many families striving for a better future through education. 

As the scheme continues to evolve, it is expected to adapt to the changing educational landscape and the needs of ex-servicemen's families. 

This commitment to education reflects a broader understanding of the importance of academic success in securing a prosperous future. 

The scheme stands as a testament to the government's efforts to uplift and empower the families of those who have served the nation.
